review.posthog_relevance: Adds ordering capability by severity to Error Tracking results, allowing users to prioritize critical errors.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the implementation of a new ordering option ('severity') for Error Tracking results. P1.F7.H6 adds the enum and API representation, P1.F7.H2 adds the ranking list and query expression, and P1.F5.H2 applies this to the query builder. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on the provided chunk; complete implementation and tests are not fully visible, though the core query and API changes are present.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation or tests for the new ordering behavior, nor does it include the backend query execution or the frontend UI changes. The chunk is dominated by schema and type changes, with only a few hunks showing the backend query builder and test changes. This makes it difficult to assess the full impact and correctness of the change.
